rv.q: Spitfire Girls is set in 1959, when the experiences of the war were still vivid in people's minds – and as such it's a timely reminder that trauma doesn't only affect those on the front line, and neither does it pass quickly.
Spitfire Girls is a terrific play, based on incredible real-life events.
This production exudes warmth and positivity.

cn.t: Critics praise "Spitfire Girls" for illuminating an overlooked chapter of WWII history with heart and depth, celebrating the women of the Air Transport Auxiliary through compelling storytelling that transcends typical wartime narratives.
